implementation_review_requirements: Implementation must record the exact controlled compiler environment and each argv; clear/declare inherited compiler include/search/loader override variables so the controlled role is meaningful.
Header path/dependency parsing must be bounded, reject virtual or unsupported/ambiguous syntax, and fail if the discovery and CPP dependency sets differ; no best-effort missing-header skip.
Any marker extraction must require unique fixed declarations and fully expanded SYS macro text. Preserve its exact expression as opaque text, without eval or kernel-number inference.

Only successful postvalidation may elevate all four observation fields. A failed compiler step, timeout, nonregular/bound-exceeding CPP/object, or changed input/self/output must remain failed and consumed.
Fixed-TU compile tests must stop at an object: no linker, executable invocation, dynamic load, syscall call or pidfd test in this phase.

Portable fixtures should cover duplicate/missing/unsafe dependency paths and markers, changed driver/header/CPP/input/output, compiler nonzero/timeout/kill/reap-unknown receipts, fresh consumption, no fallback and always-false authority.
